completed_steps: Full read of constitutional documents: core.md, THE_HAMMER_MASTER_PROMPT.md, AGENTS.md, DATABASE.md, GEMINI.md
Audit scale sovereignty (Solo doctor vs Small clinic vs Network/Multi-branch vs Master SaaS Platform Server)
Audit Drizzle schema: FK onDelete, cascade vs set null vs restrict, composite indexes for tenant-isolated hot paths
Audit data types: monetary amounts in numeric(12,2)/mode: 'number', timestamptz for dates, JSONB defaults
Audit RLS policies in rls.ts: PostgreSQL 18 compliance, fail-closed isolation, recursion prevention, bypass protection
Implement in-place schema hardening across schedule.ts, clinical.ts, billing.ts, finance.ts, auth.ts, patients.ts
Add automated schema tenant integrity test apps/api/src/db/tests/schemaTenantIntegrity.test.ts

findings.defect: Missing explicit onDelete clauses on appointments, visits, treatmentItems, and payments caused no-action defaults, leading to potential foreign key constraint violations during cancellation, soft-deletion, or test cleanup.

Frequent tenant queries filtering by (organization_id, status), (organization_id, patient_id), or (organization_id, created_at) lacked composite B-Tree indexes, threatening query degradation under large table volumes.
Solo doctor mode operates with single clinic and chair, but lacked optimized composite indexes for active chairs and staff filtering.

fixed_defects.fix: Added onDelete: 'set null' to appointments (chairId, assistantUserId, doctorUserId, patientId); added composite indexes idxAppointmentsOrgStatus and idxAppointmentsOrgPatient; added chairs orgActiveIdx.

Added onDelete: 'set null' to visits.appointmentId; added composite indexes idxVisitsOrgPatient, idxVisitsOrgCreatedAt, idxVisitsOrgStatus to visits; added onDelete: 'set null' on treatmentItems.visitId and onDelete: 'restrict' on treatmentItems.serviceId with composite indexes idxTreatmentItemsOrgPatient and idxTreatmentItemsOrgStatus.
Added onDelete: 'set null' to payments.visitId; added composite indexes idxPaymentsOrgPatient and idxPaymentsOrgStatus to payments.
Added composite indexes orgCreatedAtIdx and orgBoxCreatedAtIdx to cashOperations.
Added composite index orgRoleActiveIdx to users.
Added composite index idxPatientsOrgStatus to patients.
Created transactional migration 0208 with IF NOT EXISTS indexes and safe foreign key constraints update.
Added automated regression test verifying 4-tier scaling rules, foreign key bindings, and migration registration.
